title: Dragon Mage on Stormy Pier
description: A female mage with long flowing purple hair stands on a wooden pier, holding a glowing green staff topped with a dragon head. A massive spectral dragon with a red-to-green gradient body swirls around her, its head near the staff amid a turbulent purple sky with lightning and ethereal green figures below.
prompt: A female mage with long flowing purple hair stands on a wooden pier over stormy seas, holding a tall glowing green staff with a dragon head topper. A massive ethereal dragon with a red and green gradient body and flowing mane swirls around her in a vortex. Turbulent purple sky with lightning, glowing green spirit figures, and warriors on the waves below, dramatic fantasy scene with magical energy trails and sparks
